method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 in substance; a seat-neutral core (ira-core.l4) with one regulative rule (making the application within the time the Act fixes) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the employee bringing the claim) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, amounts or dates, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Industrial Relations Act 1996 No 17 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2025-03-02/act-1996-017 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1996-017.txt (text sha256 5354f837a966c4ad1b1a55a495fe08d50293f15a4a34d6eb9a6e712630397075). The Industrial Relations (General) Regulation, which may prescribe the s 83(1)(b), s 108A and s 379 figures, is not deposited; those figures are inputs (finding 1).
